BiblicalUsage: 1) to tread down, reject, trample down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tread down, trample (of warriors); 1a2) of rejection (fig.); 1b) (Polel); 1b1) to tread down (in bad sense); 1b2) to desecrate; 1c) (Hithpolel); 1c1) to tread; 1c2) to kick out; 1c2a) of infants' blind movements; 1c2b) of Jerusalem (fig.); 1d) (Hophal) to be trodden down
